sources.entry: Vibeyard by Eliran Tutia - A cross-platform desktop IDE that wraps Claude Code sessions with a swarm mode (parallel agents in a grid), a real-time session inspector (cost, tokens, tool-usage, context), multiple isolated Claude profiles, a kanban board, and encrypted P2P session sharing over WebRTC. Signed/notarized, broadly adopted, and built squarely for the multi-agent, multi-session workflow.

summary.one_liner: Vibeyard is a cross-platform desktop IDE that wraps AI coding agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI) with multi-session management, a swarm grid view, cost tracking, and a kanban board.
summary.what_it_does: Vibeyard runs multiple AI coding agent sessions per project, each in its own PTY, and can show them all in a swarm-mode grid. A session inspector (Cmd+Shift+I) displays real-time telemetry including timeline, cost breakdown, tool usage, and context window monitoring. Multiple Claude Code logins can run side by side, each with its own isolated config directory, selectable per session or as a per-project/global default. A per-project kanban board lets cards spawn or resume a CLI session, and tasks move to Done when their session completes. Terminal sessions can be shared with teammates over encrypted WebRTC peer-to-peer connections with read-only or read-write modes and PIN authentication. The app also includes a customizable project dashboard, an AI Readiness Score, session resume after restart, status dots on tabs, and an embedded browser tab for element inspection.
use_cases: Run several AI coding agents in parallel on one project
Track spend and token usage of Claude Code sessions
Keep separate work and personal Claude Code logins
Plan coding tasks on a kanban board and launch agent sessions from cards
Share a live terminal session with a teammate
Resume agent sessions after restarting the app
stack: Electron-style desktop app (inferred from .dmg/.exe/AppImage packaging; not named in README)
notable: Swarm mode shows all agent sessions in a grid, new sessions opened with Cmd+\
Multiple isolated Claude profiles, each with its own config directory
Encrypted P2P terminal sharing over WebRTC with PIN auth and read-only or read-write modes
Kanban cards auto-move to Done when their linked session completes
Embedded browser tab sends selected DOM element selector and page URL as context to the AI
caveats: Requires at least one supported CLI (Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Gemini CLI) installed and authenticated
Building from source requires Node v24+
README lists Linux as .deb and AppImage only, with no mention of other distros; Windows and macOS builds are offered as installers
